questions.stem_text: Calculate the binding energy of the hydrogen atom in its ground state.

B^10 is bombarded with neutrons, and \alpha particles are observed to be emitted. What is
the residual nucleus?

The quantum efficiency of a photon detector is 0.1. If 100 photons are sent into the
detector, one after the other, the detector will detect photons

options.A: an average of 10 times, with an rms deviation of about 5
options.B: an average of 10 times, with an rms deviation of about 3
options.C: an average of 10 times, with an rms deviation of about 0.1
options.D: an average of 10 times, with an rms deviation of about 1
options.E: an average of 10 times, with an rms deviation of about 6

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - an average of 10 times, with an rms deviation of about 3
